top_creatures.label: Apex dragon
top_creatures.why: Top base combat level (245) and the last step of the kill ladder; aggressive; shares its sprite slot with the black dragon
top_creatures.keep: single aggressive apex at the top of the ladder; shared sprite slot across tiers
top_creatures.change: own silhouette and palette; add a visible wind-up before the big attack; spawn gated by a zone grace timer

top_creatures.label: Glass-cannon demon
top_creatures.why: Stat skew: very high attack with low hit points, a short fight that hurts
top_creatures.change: three-hit telegraph pattern and its own sound

top_creatures.label: Waiting boulder
top_creatures.why: High-level creature that never starts a fight, so it reads as a landmark (level 150, all stats 150)
top_creatures.change: wakes only when the player enters a marked circle in a gated room

top_creatures.label: Gate titan
top_creatures.why: Non-aggressive gatekeeper at level 146 that does not chase
top_creatures.keep: does not chase; stands in the way
top_creatures.change: opens by a condition (kill count or key item), not by standing still

top_creatures.label: Ancient demon
top_creatures.why: Non-aggressive top-tier demon at level 172 with respawnTime 30
top_creatures.change: trigger is entering a sealed zone, not an attack

top_creatures.label: Two-tier demon
top_creatures.why: One silhouette in two tiers, rarity set by respawn time (level 175 with respawnTime 30; level 156 with respawnTime 73)
top_creatures.change: the higher tier gets a new ability, not a bigger number

top_creatures.label: Add-on boss
top_creatures.why: Donor-added boss above the base ladder (level 217, aggressive, respawnTime 73)
top_creatures.keep: custom top tier added above the base list

top_creatures.label: Dragon ladder
top_creatures.why: One family in tiers that shares sprite slots across dragon tiers
top_creatures.keep: tiered family with one shared sprite slot
top_creatures.change: each tier gets its own element colour and a silhouette step

originals.name: Warden's Ledger
originals.idea: A 14-step kill ladder inside one zone; each step a group of 1 to 7 creature kinds with a count, ending in one apex kill.
originals.keep: grouped tasks with rising counts and one top kill
originals.change: each step is bound to one biome and zone; each group gets two dialogue lines of its own

originals.name: Sentinel Stone
originals.idea: A high-level non-aggressive stone that does not chase and wakes only inside a marked circle.
originals.change: wakes on entry; respawn is grace-timed, not a fixed timer

originals.name: Glass Warlock
originals.idea: A short caster fight with very high attack and low hit points.
originals.change: a three-hit telegraph and a unique cast sound

originals.name: Ember Stalker
originals.idea: Same silhouette in a common tier and a rare tier; rarity set by respawn time.
originals.keep: one silhouette, two tiers, respawn as the rarity lever
originals.change: the rare tier gets one new ability

originals.name: Forge Ladder
originals.idea: Eight material steps with level gates 1, 1, 5, 10, 20, 30, 40, 60 and a power ramp.
originals.change: each step changes silhouette, not just colour; all names are ours

originals.name: Mode Kit
originals.idea: A gear kit that cannot be traded and is chosen at character creation.
originals.change: earned by a mode choice, not a level

originals.name: Mastery Track
originals.idea: Three XP curves by weapon profession, a play cap at level 7, visual-only mastery above it. Idea seen in the sibling donor opentibiabr-otclient, not in this one.
originals.change: perk lanes per level differ per weapon

originals.name: Palette Family
originals.idea: One sprite slot shared by a tier family, with colour-only variants for rare drops.
originals.change: rare variants also step the silhouette by one
